reason: The named independent lab with a report for my exact batch is what I normally have to dig for, and the dose is clear with no magnesium oxide. At $24.99 with a money-back guarantee I'd try one box and see how I sleep.
objection: Individual foil sachets for 2 capsules each is a lot of packaging waste, and a brand-new product on TikTok Shop has no reviews yet. Made in China also makes me want to open that QR report and check it is real before I reorder.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report did not match the batch number on the box, or the lab turned out to be unknown or unverifiable, I would pass.
